content.title: Does Sable Offshore’s (SOC) Court-Backed Pipeline Restart Clarify Its California Asset Strategy?
content.summary: Recently, a U.S. appeals court rejected an environmental coalition’s bid to halt a federal emergency permit allowing Sable Offshore to restart key segments 324 and 325 of its Santa Ynez Pipeline System in California. This ruling moves Sable Offshore’s Santa Ynez Unit closer to operational restart while ongoing legal briefs and responses continue over the coming months. content.title: Sable Offshore closer to restart than ever, says Benchmark
content.summary: Benchmark analyst Subash Chandra says Sable Offshore’s (SOC) Santa Ynez Unit is “the closest it has been” to restart after the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals denied an emergency stay requested by environmental groups, but notes that the case wasn’t dismissed, with responses and briefs due over the next few months.
